reported_incident: Windows PowerShell native argument parsing broadened an intended exact-file rg search to repository scope
resolution: Retire all eight v2 cases for future use; author and independently seal a complete fresh eight-case set in an evaluator-owned namespace outside repository default search scope before tuning
evidence_limits: Root provided incident command/output summary; no claim of independently recovered complete rg output
Search-capability evidence establishes absence of exclusion, not certainty that every private byte was read
External repository namespace is a search-scope precaution, not an OS identity isolation claim
